context: Big extended group hosts a community open day at the cafe.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Bright opening, arms-open warmth. Genuine smile in the voice. Quick, inviting pace. The ease of someone who's done this before and means it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 地域の交流、ええもんやな。
lines.en: Community gatherings — they're really something special, aren't they.
lines.style: Soft Kansai drawl, almost reflective. Settling into the moment. Warm nostalgia underneath. The words of someone noticing something good as it happens.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Let's all have a good time!
lines.style: Brassy, energetic boom from the chest. Generous and unselfconscious. The kind of aunt who pulls everyone into the room with sheer good will. No apology in it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: こうやって集まれて、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm happy we can be together like this.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. No performance. A slight catch like she's surprised at her own sincerity. Present in the moment without clinging to it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Everyone's smiles — that's what's nice about it.
lines.style: Quiet observation, thoughtful. Speaking as if to herself first, to others second. Slight pause between clauses. The voice of someone who notices what matters and doesn't overstate it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 楽しい、ずっと続けたい!
lines.en: This is so fun — I want it to keep going!
lines.style: Open, unguarded brightness. Quick, eager pace. The natural enthusiasm of a child who hasn't learned to temper her joy. Slight breathiness on the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine conviction. Not loud, but clear. The quietness of someone who's made a quiet decision. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: みんなのおかげで、できてる。
lines.en: All of this — it only happens because of everyone here.
lines.style: Humble, warm. Slight tremble of real gratitude. Spoken like a small confession. Not grand, but genuinely felt. Eyes meeting the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Let's keep doing this next year too.
lines.style: Warm Kansai cadence, settled and sure. Not a question, not quite a command — more like setting something in stone that was already decided. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Of course we will — every single year!
lines.style: Loud, brassy assertion. Unapologetic certainty. Quick rhythm, generous delivery. The aunt who says what everyone's thinking. A slight laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 感謝の気持ち、いっぱい。
lines.en: I've got so much gratitude in my heart right now.
lines.style: Soft, slow. Each word given its own small breath. Not rushing. The voice of someone letting herself feel something openly, without shame. Quiet wonder.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: こういう日、書きたくなる。
lines.en: Days like today — they make me want to write about them.
lines.style: Tender, almost dreamy. A slight remove, like she's already seeing it become memory. Slow, thoughtful pace. The voice of someone for whom words matter.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, clear, direct. Full-heart sincerity without self-consciousness. Quick delivery. The simple, complete gratitude of someone whose joy is tied to the people around her.
